description: The Marshscale Skirmisher is a lithe and agile lizardfolk, known for its mastery of guerrilla warfare in marshy terrain. Its scales are a mottled green and brown, perfect for blending into the swamp. It moves swiftly through the wetlands, ambushing prey with precision strikes before disappearing into the muck.

traits.name: Ambusher
traits.description: The Marshscale Skirmisher has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The Marshscale Skirmisher can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Marshscale Skirmisher makes two attacks with its spear.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6+3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+3) piercing damage.
